_notes: Scoped for a zero-dependency Node CLI. allow{} is deliberately NARROWER than the _TEMPLATE baseline: no npm/pip/cargo/go, because this project installs nothing and a builder that reaches for a package manager here has drifted from the brief. allowedDomains is EMPTY and that is the correct final value, not an unfilled placeholder — the project makes no network calls, so the sandbox denies all of them. Two enforcement layers ship: deny{} is a fast literal-prefix pass (porous by nature — casing and alternate spellings slip past), and hooks.PreToolUse -> .claude/hooks/safety_gate.js is the real semantic gate that inspects the actual tool call and blocks the one-way-door classes regardless of spelling. It fails OPEN on a parse error so a hook bug can never brick a build.
